entities.summary: The Kaunas Mosque is a World Heritage-listed Sunni Islamic mosque, located at Tatars Street 6, in the Centras eldership of Kaunas, Lithuania. It is the only mosque in the Kaunas district, one of only four mosques in Lithuania, and the only brick mosque in Lithuania and the Baltic countries.
